bio.text: John Braun is the Republican candidate for Washington's 3rd Congressional District, where he will face Democratic incumbent Marie Gluesenkamp Perez in the November 2026 election after the August primary, according to OPB.
KUOW reported in August 2025 that Braun, of Centralia, a Navy veteran and business owner, has served in the Washington State Senate since 2013 and was elected Republican Senate leader in 2020.

sources.title: Washington state Sen. John Braun to seek Marie Gluesenkamp Perez's congressional seat
